notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]User level has been added to the main menu screen
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]White strip along left side of the screen for the main menu & level select has been removed

[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0
notes.content:
[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*]Added music 
[*]Added sound effects 
[*]Mute sounds effects & music individually
[*]Added backgrounds
[*]Added levelling system with unlock-able backgrounds
[/list]
[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed puzzle UI for 4x4, 6x6, and 9x9
[*]Menu buttons now have a style to them and effects
[*]Updated how to play page
[*]Updated resolution settings for 2560x1440, 1920x1080, and 1280x720
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Puzzles now takes multiple solutions instead of just one
[*]User can no longer delete starting numbers
[/list]
